question: What supreme qualities define this goddess?
premises: She earns the supreme name through the bold act of filling all.
She is without beginning and end.
She is inclined toward the whole universe.
inference: This goddess is the timeless, all-filling supreme power whose nature is oriented toward the universe.
plain_english: This goddess, who has won the supreme name by boldly filling all, is without beginning or end and is inclined toward the whole universe.
